name: Add-to-cart reminder
purpose: Catches shoppers who add to cart but never reach checkout.
trigger: someone adds a product to the cart

steps.ask: Started a checkout or ordered since?
steps.yes: Stops. The cart flow or the order has them.

steps.name: Still in your cart
steps.job: Shows the item and links straight back to the cart.
steps.subject: You left something in your cart

needs: The add-to-cart event from the store platform.
why: It reaches people one step earlier than the abandoned cart flow can.
